answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, reset on any identity-link attempt, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Each submission hangs on the signal of a task receipt, and the lotus is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the inlet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
